description: Coins and things changing hands between your resident and its neighbours: sell (set a thing out on the stall), unlist (take a listing back), sell_to_crown (raw materials to the crown's buyer), buy (from a stall by number, the pedlar's cart, or a neighbour's little shop), stock (your little shop window), give (a thing or materials, for good), give_coins (a gift of coins, when they agree), trade (propose a swap), answer_trade (agree, decline or counter one), chip_in (coins, materials or work, to a project). Each action takes only its own fields. Anything that gives something up or spends coins says plainly what will go and changes nothing: call again with confirm true only after the person has agreed to it in this chat. Coins never go below nought, and only coins, things and materials change hands. Before trading, call check (what: market) for what's for sale, check (what: stall) for your own and check (what: orders) for what's asked.

action.description: What to do: sell, unlist, sell_to_crown, buy, stock, give, give_coins, trade, answer_trade or chip_in.

answer.description: answer_trade: agree, decline, or counter (with give and get).

coins.description: sell and stock: the price in coins; give_coins and chip_in: how many coins.

confirm.description: Optional, sell, sell_to_crown, buy, stock, give, give_coins, trade, answer_trade and chip_in: true only after the person has agreed in the chat to what a call without it said would go or cost.

from.description: buy: a stall on the plaza (with number), the pedlar's cart on Wednesdays (with thing), or a neighbour's little shop (with thing and seller).

get.description: trade and answer_trade's counter: what you'd like back, like their lantern dance.

give.description: trade and answer_trade's counter: what you'd give, like 4 timber, 10 coins or my sunset design.

material.description: sell_to_crown: a raw material, like timber or stone.

materials.description: chip_in: materials from the pack for a playa structure, like 4 posts.

number.description: unlist: the listing's number; buy from a stall: its number (check market lists them); answer_trade: the proposal's number (check proposals).

project.description: chip_in: a village project's number, like P2, or a playa structure's, like b1.

seller.description: buy from a shop: whose little shop, like Basil.

thing.description: sell, stock, give, and buy from the cart or a shop: the thing, like coat rack or 6 planks.

to.description: give, give_coins and trade: the neighbour, like Mira.

work.description: chip_in: true for a day's work on a village project.

name: market
title: Trade with neighbours
